test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All land are solid.

II. No land is boy.

**Conclusion:**

I. All solid are land.

II. All boy are solid.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/974eef1c412086e3c14c6e5bf82cbc4a0dba20449460fa9f7c28c76507b9aee0.png] 

Conclusion:

I. All solid are land. → Does not follow (As, All land are solid → Some solid are land)

II. All boy are solid. → Does not follow (As, All land are solid and No land is boy → Some boy are not solid)

Hence, '**Neither conclusion follows**' is the correct answer.
